code.title: Add-on code
code.description: The unique identifier for the add-on within its plan.

state.title: State
state.description: Add-ons can be either active or inactive.

name.title: Name
name.description: Describes your add-on and will appear in subscribers' invoices.

add_on_type.title: Add-on Type
add_on_type.description: Whether the add-on type is fixed, or usage-based.

usage_type.title: Usage Type
usage_type.description: Type of usage, returns usage type if `add_on_type` is `usage`.

usage_calculation_type.description: The type of calculation to be employed for an add-on.  Cumulative billing will sum all usage records created in the current billing cycle.  Last-in-period billing will apply only the most recent usage record in the billing period.  If no value is specified, cumulative billing will be used.

usage_percentage.title: Usage Percentage
usage_percentage.description: The percentage taken of the monetary amount of usage tracked. This can be up to 4 decimal places. A value between 0.0 and 100.0.

measured_unit_id.title: Measured Unit ID
measured_unit_id.description: System-generated unique identifier for an measured unit associated with the add-on.

liability_gl_account_id.title: General Ledger Account ID
liability_gl_account_id.description:
The ID of a general ledger account. General ledger accounts are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

revenue_gl_account_id.title: General Ledger Account ID
revenue_gl_account_id.description:
The ID of a general ledger account. General ledger accounts are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

performance_obligation_id.title: Performance Obligation ID
performance_obligation_id.description:
The ID of a performance obligation. Performance obligations are
only accessible as a part of the Recurly RevRec Standard and
Recurly RevRec Advanced features.

accounting_code.title: Accounting code
accounting_code.description: Accounting code for invoice line items for this add-on. If no value is provided, it defaults to add-on's code.

revenue_schedule_type.title: Revenue schedule type
revenue_schedule_type.description: When this add-on is invoiced, the line item will use this revenue schedule. If `item_code`/`item_id` is part of the request then `revenue_schedule_type` must be absent in the request as the value will be set from the item.

avalara_transaction_type.title: Avalara Transaction Type
avalara_transaction_type.description: Used by Avalara for Communications taxes. The transaction type in combination with the service type describe how the add-on is taxed. Refer to [the documentation](https://help.avalara.com/AvaTax_for_Communications/Tax_Calculation/AvaTax_for_Communications_Tax_Engine/Mapping_Resources/TM_00115_AFC_Modules_Corresponding_Transaction_Types) for more available t/s types.

avalara_service_type.title: Avalara Service Type
avalara_service_type.description: Used by Avalara for Communications taxes. The transaction type in combination with the service type describe how the add-on is taxed. Refer to [the documentation](https://help.avalara.com/AvaTax_for_Communications/Tax_Calculation/AvaTax_for_Communications_Tax_Engine/Mapping_Resources/TM_00115_AFC_Modules_Corresponding_Transaction_Types) for more available t/s types.

tax_code.title: Tax code
tax_code.description: Optional field used by Avalara, Vertex, and Recurly's In-the-Box tax solution to determine taxation rules. You can pass in specific tax codes using any of these tax integrations. For Recurly's In-the-Box tax offering you can also choose to instead use simple values of `unknown`, `physical`, or `digital` tax codes. If `item_code`/`item_id` is part of the request then `tax_code` must be absent.

harmonized_system_code.title: Harmonized System code
harmonized_system_code.description: The Harmonized System (HS) code is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers to classify traded products. The HS code, sometimes called Commodity Code, is used by customs authorities around the world to identify products when assessing duties and taxes. The HS code may also be referred to as the tariff code or customs code. Values should contain only digits and decimals.

display_quantity.title: Display quantity?
display_quantity.description: Determines if the quantity field is displayed on the hosted pages for the add-on.

default_quantity.title: Default quantity
default_quantity.description: Default quantity for the hosted pages.

optional.title: Optional
optional.description: Whether the add-on is optional for the customer to include in their purchase on the hosted payment page. If false, the add-on will be included when a subscription is created through the Recurly UI. However, the add-on will not be included when a subscription is created through the API.

unit_amount.title: Unit price
unit_amount.description: Allows up to 2 decimal places. Required unless `unit_amount_decimal` is provided.

unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal
unit_amount_decimal.description:
Allows up to 9 decimal places.
If `unit_amount_decimal` is provided, `unit_amount` cannot be provided.

tax_inclusive.title: Tax Inclusive?
tax_inclusive.description: This field is deprecated. Please do not use it.

code.title: Item code
code.description: Unique code to identify the item.

state.title: State
state.description: The current state of the item.

name.title: Name
name.description: This name describes your item and will appear on the invoice when it's purchased on a one time basis.

tier_type.title: Tier type
tier_type.description:
The pricing model for the add-on.  For more information,
[click here](https://docs.recurly.com/docs/billing-models#section-quantity-based). See our
[Guide](https://recurly.com/developers/guides/item-addon-guide.html) for an overview of how
to configure quantity-based pricing models.

usage_timeframe.title: Usage Timeframe
usage_timeframe.description: The time at which usage totals are reset for billing purposes.

ending_quantity.title: Ending quantity
ending_quantity.description: Ending quantity for the tier.  This represents a unit amount for unit-priced add ons. Must be left empty if it is the final tier.

unit_amount.title: Unit price
unit_amount.description: Allows up to 2 decimal places. Required unless `unit_amount_decimal` is provided.

unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal
unit_amount_decimal.description:
Allows up to 9 decimal places.
If `unit_amount_decimal` is provided, `unit_amount` cannot be provided.

ending_amount.title: Ending amount
ending_amount.description: Ending amount for the tier. Allows up to 2 decimal places. Must be left empty if it is the final tier.

usage_percentage.title: Usage Percentage
usage_percentage.description:
The percentage taken of the monetary amount of usage tracked.
This can be up to 4 decimal places represented as a string.

percentage_tiers.title: Percentage Tiers
percentage_tiers.description: This feature is currently in development and requires approval and enablement, please contact support.

external_sku.title: External SKU
external_sku.description: Optional, stock keeping unit to link the item to other inventory systems.
